Join an SJPL Works Business & Career Librarian to learn the essential elements of a successful resume and cover letter. Learn how to highlight your accomplishments and transferable skills on your resume and decide what belongs in your cover letter. No registration required. Parking validation for the garage at 88 S. 4th Street will be provided at the program. E-newsletter Signup: Get the inside scoop on business and career resources at SJPL. Sign up today for our monthly e-newsletter, highlighting the latest programs, e-resources and services available at the San José Public Library.

cases.refreshed: Join your community to help beautify your Pearl Avenue Branch Library! Register to take part in this opportunity to Volunteer Away Your Fines at a rate of $20 per hour. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone interested in volunteering away their library fines, gaining service hours for school/work, or just giving back to the community. This event will be happening at the Pearl Avenue Branch Library only. Arrive on time to sign in at the information desk. A signed waiver is required. A parent must sign for anyone under 18. Anyone under 15 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. Volunteers must commit to the full session (3:30 PM - 4:30 PM). No experience or special skills are necessary. Training and supplies are provided. For more information email pamail@sjlibrary.org or call 408-808-3053.
